title: The Ledger of the Marlowe Estate
author: Ada Pemberton
blurb: Lior Okonkwo, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
